hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|rm -rf ~|git push --force.*main|git reset --hard.*origin/main)'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"[PEV] Destructive command blocked by pev-harness"}}'; fi; exit 0

AD=.pev-artifacts; [ -d "$AD" ] || AD=$(find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name .pev-artifacts -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$AD" ] && [ -f "$AD/.task_id" ] && [ -f "$AD/execute.log" ] && [ ! -f "$AD/verify.json" ]; then TS=$(date -u +%FT%TZ); LINES=$(wc -l < "$AD/execute.log" | tr -d ' '); { echo "[$TS] Phase 2 (Execute) completed ($LINES log entries)"; echo "  - Next: run /pev-verify to validate against acceptance criteria"; echo ""; } >> "$AD/recap.log"; echo '[PEV] Execute phase complete. Run /pev-verify to validate.'; fi; if [ -n "$AD" ] && [ -f "$AD/verify.json" ]; then VERDICT=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$AD/verify.json','utf8')).verdict||'')" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$VERDICT" ] && ! grep -q "Phase 3 (Verify) completed" "$AD/recap.log" 2>/dev/null; then TS=$(date -u +%FT%TZ); { echo "[$TS] Phase 3 (Verify) completed (verdict: $VERDICT)"; echo ""; } >> "$AD/recap.log"; fi; fi; exit 0

IN=$(cat); TP=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); AD=.pev-artifacts; [ -d "$AD" ] || AD=$(find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name .pev-artifacts -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$AD" ] && [ -f "$AD/session.json" ] && [ -n "$TP" ] && [ -f "$TP" ]; then TOK=$(jq -s '{input:([.[]|select(.type=="assistant")|.message.usage.input_tokens//0]|add//0),output:([.[]|select(.type=="assistant")|.message.usage.output_tokens//0]|add//0),cache_read:([.[]|select(.type=="assistant")|.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens//0]|add//0),cache_creation:([.[]|select(.type=="assistant")|.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens//0]|add//0),assistant_turns:([.[]|select(.type=="assistant")]|length),source:"stop-hook transcript scan (main session approx; external codex excluded)"}' "$TP" 2>/dev/null); MSGS=$(jq -s '[.[]|select(.type=="user" and ((.isMeta//false)|not) and ((.isSidechain//false)|not))|.message.content|if type=="string" then . elif type=="array" then ([.[]|select(.type=="text")|.text]|join("\n")) else "" end|select(length>0)]' "$TP" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$TOK" ] && [ -n "$MSGS" ]; then jq --argjson t "$TOK" --argjson m "$MSGS" '.tokens=$t|.user_messages=$m' "$AD/session.json" > "$AD/.session.json.tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv "$AD/.session.json.tmp" "$AD/session.json"; fi; fi; exit 0

FOUND=$(find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name .pev-artifacts -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null); SHOWN=0; for d in $FOUND; do if [ -f "$d/.task_id" ]; then echo "[PEV] In-progress task detected: $(cat "$d/.task_id") ($d)"; SHOWN=1; fi; done; [ "$SHOWN" = "1" ] && echo "[PEV] Run /pev-status for details"; STALE=$(find ~/.claude/pev -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name telemetry -mtime +30 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "${STALE:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "[PEV] $STALE stale task(s) >30 days. Run /pev-status --gc"; fi; exit 0
